title: BMES Synapse Conference 2026
description: The BMES Annual Conference. Featured interactive workshops, a case competition, a keynote speaker, structured roundtable networking, and professional LinkedIn headshots.

title: Board Games & Trivia Night
location: George Vari Engineering and Computing Centre (ENG 101)
description: An evening filled with exciting games and trivia to put your knowledge to the test. The biomedical engineering community got to meet the BMES executive team for the 2024-2025 school year.

title: Alumni Night & Resume Roast
location: George Vari Engineering and Computing Centre, ENG (Sears Atrium)
description: An opportunity to network with fellow alumni, connect with industry professionals and get feedback during our Resume Roast.

title: Engineering "Trick or Treat" Pursuit
description: A collaborative event with many of the engineering student groups at TMU. Attendees visited many club offices, including the Biomedical Engineering Society office in Podium Building room 377, to get delicious and sugary treats for Halloween.

title: Pub & Karaoke Night
description: In collaboration with the Metropolitan Undergraduate Engineering Society (MUES) and Chemical Engineering Course Union (CHEMU), a social event for karaoke and food at the campus pub.

title: MetMeetMed
location: George Vari Engineering and Computing Centre (ENG LG05)
description: A panel discussion to learn about the future of health tech, specifically FemTech and fertility-related biomedical engineering, with Dr. Narjes Allahrabbi, founder & CEO of Fertilead.

title: Rest & Reset
location: George Vari Engineering and Computing Centre (ENG LG12)
description: A social event for biomedical engineers to get their minds off exams during exam season, featuring a gingerbread house making competition, bracelet making, origami, and free exam care packages. 100 exam care packages were distributed.

title: CPR-C Certification Workshop
description: A workshop to learn CPR-C and standard first aid with AED and earn certification.

title: BMES Conference 2025
description: The first BMES Annual Conference. Featured engaging discussions, hands-on workshops, valuable networking opportunities and a competitive case competition, with keynote speaker Dr. DiCecco, Assistant Professor at the University of Waterloo who leads the Regenerative Biomaterials Innovation Group.

title: Boardgames Night
location: George Vari Engineering and Computing Centre (ENG 101)
description: An evening filled with exciting games and trivia to put your knowledge to the test. The biomedical engineering community got to meet the BMES executive team for the 2025-2026 school year.

title: BME Design Competition
description: A competition to design and build biomedical bionic/prosthetic arms to complete various hands-on tasks using simple supplies found off the shelf. Teams demonstrated their designs to judges and competed for prizes.

title: Pitch Perfect Karaoke Night
description: In collaboration with the Biomedical Engineering Course Union (BECU) and Metropolitan Undergraduate Engineering Society (MUES), a fun evening to socialize and show off your karaoke skills.

title: Rest & Reset
description: A de-stress event featuring ornament decorating, gingerbread house making, care packages and free food.

title: Rewind Before the Grind
description: A de-stress event featuring board games, letter making, slime making, plant pot painting, care packages, Lego building, and a movie. Aimed toward biomedical engineering students and first-year engineering students, the event was planned and executed by the first-year representatives of the Biomedical Engineering Society.

title: BME Coop Panel
description: Talk to BME students currently in their coop and get tips and tricks to landing a coop!
